prompt_md:
# HP2P privacy sandbox

Manually authored contract artifacts from authorized HP2P requirements. These are inputs to Constrain's offline validation; no interview, LLM synthesis or independent review is claimed.

## Trust and Authority Model

A single trusted dummy-credit authority owns issuance totals, unspent provenance, accepted operation fingerprints and redemptions. Issuer keys authorize issuance; holder signatures authorize spending; advertising-recipient signatures bind claims. Signatures do not prove attention, unique humans or unlinkability. Multiple isolated authorities cannot safely finalize the same input without shared accounting. No production financial backend is connected.

## Component Topology

The sandbox depends on Node's built-in cryptography. Credits and subscriptions use the sandbox signature helpers. Stateless transport is separate from monetary accounting. Publisher signatures authenticate one publisher; symmetric group keys allow any key holder to author messages. Monthly key rotation and the negotiation-window helper do not implement billing or key distribution.

## Acceptance evidence

The PACT contract and Node tests exercise dummy-credit conservation, invalid provenance, replay, failure atomicity, expiry, domain separation, subscription authentication and monthly boundaries. Boundary records pin exact identifiers to implementation and requirement/test sources. Passing structural validation is not a proof of production security or anonymous payments.

## Composed publisher subscriptions

The publisher-only encrypted channel composes a scoped publisher signature inside the current monthly symmetric envelope. Opening verifies both mechanisms and matches the inner and outer channel, month and message id. It does not reject an unchanged replay or enforce payment-based key delivery. The refreshed named-review packet includes this composition alongside the clarified economic adapters. Mechanical contract checks and executable tests remain distinct acceptance evidence.

## Clarified economics

A signed promise is pending until a settlement authority accepts it. Optional unexpected superlikes that lack verified settlement reduce to ordinary likes, without spendable balance or paid entitlement. Advertising is a closed designated-credit campaign budget with collected proofs bound to campaign, action and recipient; those proofs do not establish human attention. Monthly subscription access requires verified settled funds for the corresponding recipient, channel and epoch. These semantics are exercised only with dummy credits and explicit in-memory authority state.
constraints_yaml:
constraints:
  - id: sandbox-only
    severity: must
    text: No live funds, network settlement, wallets, financial accounts, token sales, or production financial backend.
  - id: conserve-supply
    severity: must
    text: Issued dummy units equal outstanding plus redeemed separately for ordinary and advertising credits.
  - id: single-authority-state
    severity: must
    text: Keep unspent provenance and accepted operation fingerprints in one authority; reject duplicate spends and conflicting retries within the currency/action/signer/id namespace before monetary mutation.
  - id: honest-privacy
    severity: must
    text: Declare pseudonym linkage, replica double-spend risk and the inability of signed video evidence to prove human attention.
  - id: monthly-keys
    severity: must
    text: Rotate symmetric monthly keys; bind publisher messages to publisher, channel and epoch; use an inclusive seven-day negotiation window on each side of the month boundary.
  - id: composed-publisher-encryption
    severity: must
    text: Sign publisher text and its channel, epoch and message id before monthly encryption; verify the configured publisher and matching inner/outer scope after decryption. Group keys do not grant publisher authority.
  - id: monotonic-authority-time
    severity: must
    text: Reject backwards trusted authority time even after a rejected request; later observations may advance the clock guard without changing monetary state.
  - id: pending-is-not-settled
    severity: must
    text: A signed proposal or IOU is pending until the dummy settlement authority accepts it; caller-supplied claims must not create settled balances or paid entitlements.
  - id: superlike-fallback
    severity: must
    text: An optional superlike without verified settled funds reduces to an ordinary like and conveys no settled donation or paid entitlement.
  - id: closed-ad-campaign
    severity: must
    text: Advertising rewards are restricted to separately designated campaign credits, with proofs bound to campaign, action, recipient and budget; exact retries must not spend twice.
  - id: subscription-settlement-gate
    severity: must
    text: Release monthly subscription access only for verified settled funds tied to the recipient, channel and epoch; pending promises and fabricated receipt objects must not unlock access.
trust_policy_yaml:
authority_map:
- component: credits
  domains:
  - dummy.unspent
  - dummy.operations
  - dummy.issuance
  - dummy.redemptions
- component: subscriptions
  domains:
  - local.channel_keys
- component: signatures
  domains: []
- component: use_cases
  domains:
  - dummy.campaign.budget
  - dummy.subscription.capacity
  - dummy.pending.promises
trust:
  floor: 0
notes:
- Issuer signatures are necessary for issuance but do not prove scarcity across replicas.
- Holder signatures bind requests but do not prove unique humans, viewing or attention.
- These in-memory records have no durability, anonymous-payment or offline-finality
  guarantee.
- Pending promises and collected proofs are not settled funds. Only authority acceptance
  releases dummy reward or subscription outcomes.

schema_hints_yaml:
currency_kind: [ordinary, advertising]
units: positive safe integers
signature_scheme: Ed25519 with domain-separated canonical payloads
symmetric_cipher: AES-256-GCM with authenticated channel, epoch and message id
month_format: YYYY-MM in UTC
replay_key: currency/action/signer/id namespace plus request fingerprint
claim_replay_key: recipient signer plus claim id
authority_clock: nondecreasing trusted observation including rejected requests
provenance: unspent output reference owned by the signing key
reward_binding: [offerHash, challenge, evidenceHash, requirementsHash]
